text:
Tara: quick one 11 RetailEdge running a short POC. They asked for a tiny compliance pack: SOC2 controls excerpt (storage + network), a signed pen-test attestation, a presigned upload URL, and a clear Dedicated burst line-item for quoting. Can we split?
Ibrahim: I can pull the SOC2 controls and redact hostnames. Do they need control IDs?
Tara: yes include IDs and a plain-language blurb. Also they called out EU data residency for uploads.
Helen: Legal needs vendor + scan scope + POC contact to sign the pen-test attestation. @Raj 1 vendor/contact?
Raj: vendor = BlueAegis. contact = secops@retailedge.com. scope = external app + one staging subnet.
Helen: thanks. I'll draft the attestation and sign once SOC2 excerpt is confirmed redacted.
Ibrahim: excerpt done, replaced hostnames with placeholders and added EU residency note. Will attach index of included artifacts.
Tara: presign preferred (they asked for 48h). Can we do 48h with auto-delete in 7 days?
SalesOpsBot: Reminder: default presign is 24h; 48h is allowed for POCs if Legal approves retention.
Raj: Legal ok with 48h retention + auto-delete in 7 days.
Tara: perfect. Helen, can you sign today?
Helen: signing now. Draft attestation: "We confirm BlueAegis performed an external webapp and staging network scan during the POC window. Redwood Inference attests no customer keys were accessed." Will attach signed PDF.
SalesOpsBot: For Dedicated bursts: standard uplift for short bursts is shown as ~20% of committed unit price. If you give committed baseline (GPUs/hours) I can produce a line-item quote.
Tara: baseline = 6 x A10g for 48h, expecting 4h/day burst for 3 days.
SalesOpsBot: I'll post a quick estimate in the morning.
Helen: signed attestation uploaded.
Ibrahim: presign issued (48h): https://s3-presign.example/re-5201 (expires in 48h). Auto-delete scheduled in 7 days.
Tara: Sending consolidated package to secops@retailedge.com now with SOC2 excerpt, signed attestation, presign link and a note about burst pricing. Closing after upload confirms. :thumbsup:
RetailEdge (via email): "Thanks 1 uploading now. Can you confirm you won't retain copies longer than 7 days?"
Helen: Confirmed auto-delete in 7 days; contact support@redwood.com for exceptions.
Tara: great, thread closed once upload completes.
